form.scope: A bounded form within the cumulative bank. Form completion is separate from blueprint coverage.

criteria.checked: Exact authored choice/text checks; preserve initial, supported, repaired and unresolved evidence separately.
criteria.spoken: Local recording or explicit aloud practice and each rubric self-report; no verified pronunciation, intelligibility or oral proficiency score.
criteria.open_writing: Original draft plus each rubric self-report; no automatic semantic or composition proficiency score.
criteria.writing: Keep guided, unsupported, paper and unverified outcomes separate; recognition cannot replace writing.
criteria.placement: Practice and sampled checks do not award placement. Unsampled or unassessed blueprint facets remain unresolved.

blueprint.remediation: Use each bank reference’s exact canonical lesson and notebook display. Preserve current access, skipped history and compatible evidence; retry only missing or revised facets.
blueprint.revision_binding: Course, milestone, bank-item and definition fingerprints; a changed learning contract requires fresh evidence.
blueprint.retake: An explicit new form index rotates deterministic target selections within each domain; repeated familiar items are labelled practice, never unseen proficiency evidence.

The reader can identify whom or what I mean.

definition.summary: Form complete does not mean blueprint complete or proficiency verified. Review the exact observed facets and remaining coverage.

domains.name: Recognize characters and connect form with reading and meaning
Understand and retrieve words in context
Understand and produce the level’s main constructions
Sound, listening, speaking, interaction, composition and pragmatic outcomes

form.scope: A bounded form within the cumulative bank. Form completion is separate from blueprint coverage.

criteria.checked: Exact authored choice/text checks; preserve initial, supported, repaired and unresolved evidence separately.
criteria.spoken: Local recording or explicit aloud practice and each rubric self-report; no verified pronunciation, intelligibility or oral proficiency score.
criteria.open_writing: Original draft plus each rubric self-report; no automatic semantic or composition proficiency score.
criteria.writing: Keep guided, unsupported, paper and unverified outcomes separate; recognition cannot replace writing.
criteria.placement: Practice and sampled checks do not award placement. Unsampled or unassessed blueprint facets remain unresolved.

assessment.remediation: Use each bank reference’s exact canonical lesson and notebook display. Preserve current access, skipped history and compatible evidence; retry only missing or revised facets.
assessment.revision_binding: Course, milestone, bank-item and definition fingerprints; a changed learning contract requires fresh evidence.
assessment.retake: An explicit new form index rotates deterministic target selections within each domain; repeated familiar items are labelled practice, never unseen proficiency evidence.
